ownedDrain.note: Event-driven QA-owned cleanup bookkeeping only. Register each owned Promise before wait, or synchronously/asynchronously within a retirement that has not yet completed. Promise/thenable identity is deduplicated across this tracker: only its first accepted retirement runs. A fulfilled/rejected producer is not complete until its retirement (including any returned Promise and newly registered followers) finishes. Producer rejection alone is not a cleanup failure. Capacity is a lifetime entry bound, including completed entries; rejected capacity registrations are not observed and remain the caller's cleanup responsibility. The first wait uses one overall deadline with no polling and returns one fixed immutable report. Timeout does not cancel producer/retirement Promises; already accepted and later capacity-eligible followers continue best-effort, and later snapshots may differ from that fixed wait result. Work registered after an already completed wait cannot retroactively change its result. Reports retain primitive labels/status only, not values, raw errors, resources or Promises. This tracker performs no rendering, Game, storage or GPU operation.

note: Separate8851 genuine-memory QA. Only an owned original LivePlayerRig and owned ProductionArt are loaded; no Game, tick, main Renderer or user state is used. Twelve controlled render-only actor samples (two weapons, six movement/aim histories) call the original public player.frame API. Its original two GL draws and original body read are unchanged. One additional post-frame native body Canvas RGBA capture per sample is quality/input collection only. Body geometry is compared exactly; contact sheets separately show the original armed colour/outline canvas, not the computational mask. The fused helper is not installed in rasterFrame: these checks do not certify whole-canvas candidate AB or relax any previous failed native frame gate. Fixed CPU helper A1/B/A2 uses those same cached native RGBA inputs,120 warmup calls per arm outside timing and2400 calls per arm in12 batches of200. Both paths include the same scalar output consumer; timings are CPU call wall, not GPU time, presented FPS, whole-frame improvement or peak memory. No retries or product adoption. Browser URL/decoded/driver caches can remain resident. Failed parallel player loads can have unobservable sibling requests, explicitly making cleanup unproven. Original loadModels also creates an animation-only authored GLTF scene outside its model map; this route retires visible owned models/materials/textures, not a separately unretained loader graph. Raw RGBA storage is bounded to3MiB, one1KiB row scratch is reused, and returned geometry objects are fresh. One additional256KiB validation copy is live at a time, outside timers; the3MiB limit describes retained raw inputs, not peak process memory. FNV32 fields are diagnostics only; equality is checked by full byte comparison and recursive Object.is geometry comparison. Dependency or external-clock injection is diagnostic only and cannot certify a CPU-helper win.
